# GeorgeAI

> GeorgeAI is the studio of George Sebastian Cucuiet, a Germany-based AI automation
> and full-stack developer. The studio builds AI automations, chatbots, AI phone
> agents, and growth systems (SEO/AIO/GEO, email, lead generation), plus custom
> software (Python, Django, CRMs, micro-ERPs, SaaS) for small and mid-sized businesses.

Contact: contact@georgeai.dev · +49 160 4155546 · Germany (services delivered remotely, EU & worldwide). Languages: English, German, Romanian, Arabic.

## Services — Automation & AI
- [Automation](https://georgeai.dev/services/automation/): Custom n8n workflows that move data between CRMs, email, sheets, APIs and LLMs so repetitive manual work disappears. Stack: n8n, Python, OpenAI, Webhooks.
- [AI Chatbot](https://georgeai.dev/services/ai-chatbot/): A website assistant trained on your own content (RAG) that answers questions, qualifies leads and books appointments. Stack: OpenAI, RAG, WhatsApp, n8n.
- [AI Phone Calls](https://georgeai.dev/services/ai-phone-calls/): AI voice phone agents with a custom voice that answer, qualify and book 24/7. Stack: Phone AI, OpenAI, Twilio, n8n.
- [RAG](https://georgeai.dev/services/rag/): Retrieval-Augmented Generation that grounds chatbots and phone agents in your own documents for source-backed answers. Stack: Vector DB, OpenAI, Embeddings.

## Services — Growth & Marketing
- [SEO / AIO / GEO](https://georgeai.dev/services/seo-aio-geo/): Optimisation for search engines (SEO), AI Overviews (AIO) and generative engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity (GEO). Stack: DataForSEO, WordPress, Python, OpenAI.
- [Email Marketing](https://georgeai.dev/services/email-marketing/): Automated, segmented email flows with strong deliverability. Stack: Mautic, Brevo, Sendy, Amazon SES.
- [Lead Generation](https://georgeai.dev/services/lead-generation/): Automated sourcing, enrichment, AI scoring and CRM routing of qualified prospects. Stack: n8n, Python, CRM, LinkedIn.
- [Web Design Optimization](https://georgeai.dev/services/web-design-optimization/): Conversion-focused optimisation of an existing site — speed, layout, copy, SEO. Stack: CRO, SEO, Analytics, A/B testing.

## Services — Software & Data
- [Python Programming](https://georgeai.dev/services/python-programming/): Backends, APIs, automations and data tooling. Stack: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker.
- [Django](https://georgeai.dev/services/django/): Full-stack web platforms, dashboards and portals with secure APIs. Stack: Django, Python, PostgreSQL, REST.
- [Micro ERP](https://georgeai.dev/services/micro-erp/): Lightweight custom ERP — inventory, invoicing, orders, reporting. Stack: Django, PostgreSQL, Supabase, REST.
- [CRM](https://georgeai.dev/services/crm/): Tailored CRM integrated with email, phone and automation. Stack: Django, PostgreSQL, n8n, REST.
- [SaaS Projects](https://georgeai.dev/services/saas-projects/): End-to-end SaaS — auth, billing, dashboards, APIs. Stack: Django, React, Stripe, PostgreSQL.
- [API Integration & Data Analytics](https://georgeai.dev/services/api-integration-data-analytics/): Integrations across platforms plus unified analytics dashboards. Stack: REST, Python, n8n, PostgreSQL.

## Services — Web
- [Web Design](https://georgeai.dev/services/web-design/): Fast, responsive, multilingual websites with SEO and automation built in. Stack: Next.js, WordPress, HTML/CSS, Figma.

- Business: a complete solution for one workflow (~4 weeks base).
- Scale-up: multiple integrated systems (~8 weeks base).
- Add-ons: multilingual (5 languages), ongoing support & maintenance, hosting & monitoring, team training.
